text:
STANLEY:
  Brave Richmond, you've done well today!
  Look. Here is the crown he stole and held so long.
  I pulled it off the dead head of this bloody wretch,
  and now it will grace yours.
  Wear it. Enjoy it. Make the most of it.
RICHMOND:
  Great God in heaven, say Amen to all of this!
  But tell me, is young George Stanley alive?
STANLEY:
  He is, my lord, and safe in the town of Leicester.
  If you're willing, we can go there now.
